Design saved to [/tmp/labour-design-astra.md](/tmp/labour-design-astra.md).

Recommend private aggregation inside `partyChart`, preserving its call and return shape. Map exactly `Labour (Co-op)` to `Labour`, sum signed decimals with scaled `bigint`, retain null when all amounts are unknown, and sum both counts. Unite becomes one Labour slice totaling `618900`. API and recipient labels remain unchanged.

Explicit policy choice: aggregate signed totals before excluding negative totals from pie weights. This keeps the tooltip amount consistent with the grouped slice.
